findings.claim: 'No declaration detected by A was missed by B' and the rustdoc of default_first_use_check ('at equality it costs as much and is exact') hold only on the tested sets. In general the V31 default (All) misses rounding-limited wrong declarations that the V29 default (MultiColouring) detects; NOTES and REPORT say only that this is 'not excluded'.
findings.evidence: Reviewer probe /tmp/claude-1000/-home-cosmosapjw-vigilode/d057eb25-bf20-49ac-a1df-6dd2adc8a0a4/scratchpad/review_V31_ASSEMBLY_DEFAULT_WIDE_BAND/probes/review_v31_p3_portable.rs. Pattern: the builder's wide pattern random_band_rows(60,27,0.1,1), total_groups 111, band moduli [55,56]. Row i is (1 + 1e6(1 - y_j)) + 3*2^-29*y_k, where (i,j) is declared and (i,k) is not; k = j +/- 55 or 56 (same group of a further colouring, other client colour); y_j = 1, y_k = 0. Shifting y_k alone adds 0.75 of half an ulp at f_i = 1 and is lost to rounding; with y_j also shifted, f_i lies in [0.5,1) and a bit changes. At commit 1952c87c the default detects 160 of 160 decisions (80 cases x seq/t3, MultiColouringEntryDiffers); logs/p3_portable_A.log. At HEAD the default is All and passes all 160 with 60/61 RHS; logs/p3_portable_B2.log. An earlier HEAD run reused the commit-A library because the target dir was shared; it is kept as logs/p3_portable_B_INVALID_reused_commitA_lib.log. Explicit All passes and explicit MC fails (probe.log, P3: 40/40).
findings.correction: Add one sentence to the rustdoc of default_first_use_check and CheckColumns::All. It should say that the full check is not a superset of MC under rounding: an omission whose effect is visible only in a multi-column state can be detected by MC and missed by All (reproducer above). Write 'exact up to rounding' at equality, and change the open issue from 'not excluded' to 'exists (constructed)'. The practical impact is negligible: the coupling is 5.6e-9 next to an entry of 1e6, and All gains the structural cases that MC misses (L-0338). The owner decision is unaffected.

findings.claim: The rustdoc parenthesis '(wide declared bands)' for when the rule picks All is incomplete. All is also picked for irregular sparse patterns, where the MC band construction degenerates to n single-column groups (the same states as All, so detection is identical), and for small-n diagonal or empty patterns.
